data.title: Rename Cairn → Etch everywhere

data.body:
## ETCH-15 complete — PR #16 open

https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/16

**LOC:** 55 files changed, +704/−650 (mechanical Cairn→Etch rename + new cutover-guard tests).

### End-of-task verification (all green)
```
=== 1. BUILD ===            build OK ✓
=== 2. TESTS ===            go test ./...  → all packages ok ✓
=== 3. SMOKE ===            SMOKE PASSED — install + capture verified end-to-end ✓
  ✓ info returns name=etch
  ✓ exactly 1 ref under refs/etch/sessions/
  ✓ session.json schema_version = etch.session.v1

=== 4a. code grep (production) ===   zero hits ✓
=== 4b. active docs grep ===         clean (only intentional "Formerly Cairn" note) ✓
=== 4c. old files ===
  CAIRN.md gone ✓
  CAIRN_PLAN.md gone ✓
  entire-agent-cairn-poc renamed ✓
  cmd/entire-agent-cairn renamed ✓
```
The only remaining `cairn` strings are intentional: the new cutover-guard test
(`TestCaptureOrchestration_LegacyCairnIgnored` asserts legacy CAIRN_* are ignored)
and SPEC.md's true historical "Formerly Cairn / Forge++" note.

### Wide sweep (environment-wide)
- `~/.claude`, installed binaries, git refspecs, `~/.cairn`, live `refs/cairn/*`: all clean.
- 🚩 **lattice-orchestrator skill**: ETCH-12's CAIRN_* export block (d44c948) was never merged to
  c11 HEAD — live skill exports nothing, so no CAIRN_* to flip. Re-landing as ETCH_* is ETCH-12 scope.
- 🚩 **code/Forge++/**: ancestral pre-rename snapshot, superseded by code/Etch/ — left for archive/delete decision.

### Commits
1. `872cd3f` rename across code, binary, env vars, schema, refs
2. `6fd4798` rename across documentation

Own-reviewer fallback (lattice auto-review diffed the main checkout → empty; reviewed worktree diff directly). Verdict: APPROVED. Clean mechanical three-way rename — no over-replacement (module path forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch intact, no mangled tokens), build + full test suite + make smoke all green, production code 100% grep-clean. New cutover-guard tests assert legacy CAIRN_* are ignored.
